messages:
maria: dropping RN + internal announce for v2.7-quant-lite. need pin owner + canary watcher. plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~90m. rollback triggers: error rate >2x baseline for 3m OR p95 >600ms for 10m. snippet below.

maria: RN draft:
• What: v2.7-quant-lite — lighter quant kernels, ~15% throughput uplift on mid-long workloads
• Fixes: faster KV cache priming; mitigates occasional streaming stalls
• Compatibility: Dedicated customers will automatically fall back to v2.6 when GPU pool constrained

maria: internal snippet: "Heads up: v2.7 rollout at 13:00 UTC — improves throughput and cache warmup. Ops monitoring; will post status updates."

alex: i can pin the model and run the deploy. proposed pin id: model-redwood/v2.7-q1 pinned to inference-v2.7.

sam: i'll own the rollback watch and final GO/NO-GO. i'll wire alerts + a short heartbeat and will be paged on the 25% promote.

alex: deploy-bot params below. scheduling 2025-10-01T13:00:00Z.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy created by @alex. job id: db-2199999999. commands:
```
deploy-bot run db-2199999999 --stage canary --percent 5 --wait 900 --debug-logs true
deploy-bot promote db-2199999999 --percent 25 --wait 3600 --dns-hold 300
deploy-bot promote db-2199999999 --percent 100
deploy-bot rollback db-2199999999 --reason "rollback gate triggered"
```

sam: please add --fallback-delay 600 on the 25% promote to avoid quick weight flips.

lee: docs will push the internal snippet at T-10 and prep the release notes entry. i'll be on standby for in-run copy edits. :eyes: 

maria: final checklist: model pin set, deploy job scheduled & queued, rollback watch assigned, internal blurb ready. go/no-go check at 12:40 UTC.

deploy-bot: job db-2199999999 created and moved to queued state by @alex.
